scope.provenance: Contact-sheet manifest records a110 captures. Parent states only JS race fixes separate a110 from450; no claim that these images are final450 captures.
scope.method: Every one of the36 sheets was opened using view_image and every pair reviewed. No server, browser session, test run, production access or app-source edit by reviewer.
scope.limitations: Visual-only status. MATCH is limited to visible content and does not certify interactions, full workflow, offscreen controls, other widths, backend or hosted preview. No blanket PASS.
